review_notes: I read the whole file. The proofs are short and do different things: unfolding the restricted homomorphism, a membership rewrite, openness through the discrete quotient topology, triviality in dimension at most one, and isometry transport. The only repeated text is the spinorNorm expression `CliffordAlgebra.spinorNorm (Q.baseChange ℚ_[p]) (QuadraticForm.Nondegenerate.baseChange hQ)`. That is notation repeated in statements, not repeated reasoning. The `QuotientAddGroup.discreteTopology` call appears once here. A grep found other uses elsewhere in the repo, but they are in unrelated contexts and take already-open hypotheses. None repeats the square-subgroup openness argument, so a shared lemma would not be justified under this rubric.
